title: Free coordinates after fixing a list
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho$ assign a restriction state to each of the $n$ coordinates, and let $A$ be a finite set of coordinates such that every coordinate free under $\rho$ belongs to $A$. Let $L$ be a list of coordinates and let $x$ be a bit assignment. After fixing the coordinates in $L$ according to $x$, every coordinate that remains free belongs to $A\setminus L$, where $L$ is viewed as the set of its entries.
